_transfer: applies anti-bot/limit checks, triggers swapBack, sets fee mode and calls _tokenTransfer

setAutomatedMarketMakerPair: onlyOwner marks or unmarks an AMM pair

_tokenTransfer: dispatches to excluded/standard transfer variants
_transferStandard: standard reflection transfer with fee and liquidity handling
_takeLiquidity: accrues liquidity/marketing tokens and contract reflections per buy/sell mode

_getValues: computes r/t amounts, fees and liquidity shares
_getRate: divides reflection supply by token supply

calculateLiquidityFee: amount multiplied by _liquidityFee divided by 10000

restoreAllFee: restores previously saved fees

_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair: internal AMM pair configuration and reward exclusion
_approve: internal allowance setter emitting Approval
